provenance.catalogue: Gaia DR3 astrometry/photometry + Bailer-Jones et al.2021 EDR3 geometric distances
provenance.credit: ESA/Gaia/DPAC; Bailer-Jones, Rybizki, Fouesneau, Demleitner and Andrae (2021); GAVO
provenance.query: SELECT TOP 8000 source_id,ra,dec,pmra,pmdec,parallax,parallax_error,phot_g_mean_mag,phot_bp_mean_mag,phot_rp_mean_mag,ruwe,r_med_geo,r_lo_geo,r_hi_geo FROM gedr3dist.litewithdist WHERE 1=CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS',ra,dec),CIRCLE('ICRS',83.6334511837,22.0151236394,1.4325437375665075)) AND r_med_geo BETWEEN 1950 AND 2050 AND phot_g_mean_mag<16 AND ruwe<1.4 AND parallax>5*parallax_error ORDER BY phot_g_mean_mag,source_id
provenance.selection: Authored spherical neighbourhood with radial taper. RUWE<1.4 and parallax/error>5; bounded brightness-ordered query. Distance medians and16/84percentiles retained; no cluster membership inferred.
provenance.retainedSources: The explicitly named Crab pulsar retains its prior scene placement; surrounding Gaia field rows use Bailer-Jones median distances.
